items.claim: Three close-class devices stand inside Ezek.11.1-Ezek.11.13 and none is named: the utterance signature at 11:8, and the second-person-plural recognition refrain at 11:10 and again at 11:12. The unit's own category sentence denies that its close is a recognition or utterance refrain, and both refrains in fact stand three verses and one verse in front of the closing verse. Second, 11:5 carries the address verb together with the Spirit falling on the prophet, which is the seam-grade device the book uses inside a vision; the 11:5 alternative is declined for want of a word-event form and an addressee shift, which is the test for an oracle unit and not the test for a scene inside a vision. Third, the pe entered against 11:1 divides 11:1 from 11:2 and therefore stands interior to the span, yet it is cited as corroboration of the onset at 11:1 while the pe against 11:6 is correctly called interior; no mark stands behind 11:1, since MT ch 10 carries none at all, so the onset rests on the transport verb by itself.
items.both_sides: The span stands as one scene on both of its seams. Front seam 10:22/11:1: the close side completes the river-Chebar identification and carries no mark anywhere in that chapter; the onset side carries the transport of the prophet to the east gate. Back seam 11:13/11:14: the close side reports Pelatiah's death and the prophet's cry, with a pe against 11:13; the onset side is the strict word-event form. The interior candidate at 11:5 does not cut, because Jaazaniah and Pelatiah are named at 11:1 and Pelatiah dies at 11:13, an inclusio of participants that binds the span, and the twenty-five men stay in view throughout; the utterance at 11:8 and the refrains at 11:10 and 11:12 are therefore paragraph-final within the scene rather than row-final, since the narrative consequence at 11:13 still follows them.

suggested_fix.fact: The span holds the utterance signature at 11:8 and the second-person-plural recognition refrain at 11:10 and 11:12, each paragraph-final inside the courtyard scene; 11:5 carries the address verb with the Spirit falling and is the vision-internal device on which the 11:5 cut is properly declined; the pe entered against 11:1 is interior to the span and the onset carries no mark behind it.
